odteste.elemento.revelado: Something inside you answers to the name. It was always %s.
odteste.comando.elemento.escondido: %s's element: %s (hidden: the player doesn't know yet).
odteste.comando.elemento.erro.sem: %s has no element to reveal. Set one first: /odteste elemento <player> <element>.
odteste.comando.erro.elemento: Unknown element: %s. Use nenhum, sangue, conhecimento, morte or energia.
odteste.horror.exposicao.comum.1: Nothing has looked at you. Yet.
odteste.horror.exposicao.comum.3: You are still just one more.
odteste.horror.exposicao.baixa.1: You heard something. It heard you.
odteste.horror.exposicao.media.1: There are footsteps that match yours.
odteste.horror.exposicao.alta.1: Someone is in the corner of your eye. Still there.
odteste.horror.exposicao.alta.3: What looks back already knows your name.
odteste.horror.exposicao.critica.1: It is no longer you who is searching.
odteste.horror.exposicao.critica.2: The door is open. On the other side, they wait for you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.1: Feet on the ground. For now.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.2: What you see is what exists.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.3: Breathe. Everything is in its place.
odteste.horror.lucidez.alta.1: Something is out of place. You haven't found it yet.
odteste.horror.lucidez.media.1: You no longer trust what you hear.
odteste.horror.lucidez.media.2: The door you closed is open.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.1: Your own voice whispers from across the room.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.2: You no longer know who is calling you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.3: What is real moves away from you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.surto.2: There is no ground. Only what you think there is.
odteste.horror.lucidez.surto.3: You got lost and never found the way.
odteste.configuration.title: Gabinete do Limiar
odteste.configuration.efeitos_fortes.too: Shake, flash and darkness of the scares. Can be lowered, not turned off: SOFT halves them; MINIMUM makes them much weaker.
odteste.configuration.intensidade.toolti: Grey sky, fog and darkness of the world, day and night. From 50% to 100%: can be lowered, not turned off.
odteste.grupo.erro.nome: Invalid name: %s (lowercase letters, numbers and _, up to 24).
odteste.grupo.erro.sem_grupo: There is no group %s. Create it with /odteste grupo criar.
odteste.mestre.ouvir.nao_jogador: Only a player can turn listen mode on or off.
odteste.mestre.ouvir.on: Game master listening: on. In spectator, you see the scares of whoever you watch, without counting for any rule.
odteste.mestre.status.hora.noite: It is night now (dawn in ~%s min).
odteste.mestre.status.hora.dia: It is day now (dark in ~%s min).
odteste.mestre.status.membro: %s: Exposure %s (%s), Lucidity %s of %s. Scares this night: %s.
odteste.artefato.em_breve: This object's power is coming soon.
item.odteste.sede_de_domingo.desc: A butcher's cleaver worn into a half-moon. Smells of iron.
item.odteste.sabre_do_ultimo_adeus.desc: An honor guard's saber. One name is still missing from the list.
item.odteste.sentenca_sem_recurso.desc: A courtroom sword with no edge. The engraved lines move around.
item.odteste.espeto_da_casa_cheia.desc: A barbecue skewer with a jury-rigged wire. Smells of charcoal and ozone.
item.odteste.seringa_velha.desc: Use: trade a little of your blood for strength.
item.odteste.medalha_de_doador.desc: When your life hangs by a thread, it slowly comes back.
item.odteste.medalha_de_doador.preco: Every return weighs on your mind.
item.odteste.oculos_de_velorio.desc: Shows what does not want to be seen.
item.odteste.oculos_de_velorio.preco: Whoever looks is also looked at. Sometimes you hear things.
item.odteste.moeda_de_defunto.desc: Once a night, death passes you by and monsters forget you.
item.odteste.moeda_de_defunto.preco: Weighs on your mind. Then it goes cold until the next night.
item.odteste.vela_de_setimo_dia.desc: Lit, it weakens the walking dead nearby.
item.odteste.vela_de_setimo_dia.preco: The candle burns down. Remembering the dead is tiring.
item.odteste.lupa_do_arquivo_morto.desc: In books, shows passages that were hidden.
item.odteste.lupa_do_arquivo_morto.preco: Every passage revealed weighs on your mind.
item.odteste.fita_sem_etiqueta.desc: A cassette tape patched with tape. Someone recorded over it.
item.odteste.fita_sem_etiqueta.preco: The answer always brings one sentence too many.
item.odteste.uma_barra_de_sinal.desc: Recharges devices you carry. Use: a pulse stuns those nearby.
item.odteste.uma_barra_de_sinal.preco: Wears out. At night, it sometimes rings by itself.
item.odteste.fusivel_queimado.desc: Dark glass, black wire. Still warm.
item.odteste.fusivel_queimado.preco: When a machine fails, the paranormal notices.
item.odteste.radinho_de_pilha.desc: The static grows louder as danger comes closer.
item.odteste.radinho_de_pilha.preco: Silence weighs on your mind. Sometimes there are voices in the static.
